page.overview:
Who is Dynios?

is a mage whose soul is permanently trapped in Prism Grimpoppy's wizard spellbook, which now serves as his body. As an NPC, Dynios is played by Matthew Mercer.

Dynios is now a beautiful brown and black leather spellbook inscribed with silver runes. On its front is a "scrunched" face with only slits for eyes.

Dynios is conceited and proud, and even when sealed in a book he has an air of superiority, having a very good opinion of himself.

Dynios is a mage from the Shadowfell that was trapped in a spellbook during a rivalry. It fell into the hands of the Cobalt Soul, and was sent out with Prism to act as her chaperone while she went on her first fact-gathering assignment for the Soul.
